source: StockCharts ChartSchool, Moving Averages - Simple and Exponential
source_convention: EMA uses multiplier 2 / (timeperiod + 1); the first EMA is seeded with the simple average of the first timeperiod values.

arithmetic.rule: For the arithmetic progression close[t] = t, the SMA seed at t = N is (N + 1) / 2. Applying alpha = 2 / (N + 1) makes every subsequent EMA equal t - (N - 1) / 2.
